definitions.baseline: for AFFECT_ANY/NEGATIVE/POSITIVE/SURPRISE and PHRASE:* the 'absent' group is thoughts with no NEGATIVE/POSITIVE/SURPRISE hit at all; for CHANGE_INTENT/NEUTRAL* it is thoughts without that keyword class
definitions.fisher: two-sided Fisher exact test implemented with lgamma (sum of hypergeometric probabilities <= observed); chi2_p is Pearson chi-square (1 df) via erfc; thoughts are autocorrelated within an episode so both are anti-conservative
